title: HarderDifficulty
description: This datapack adds custom mobs, recipes, and weapons in a vanilla style
body:
This datapack makes minecraft harder, by improving the zombies, skeletons, creepers, endermans, spiders and more. 

There are 3 new recipes and a new armor set. Zombies drop the helmet, skeletons drop the boots, spiders drop the leggins and creepers drop the chestplate but the chance is very low.

This datapack is in process, the objetive is to improve all the hostile and neutral mobs and add new vanilla style bosses, custom armor and weapons ,structures and a new dimension.
